evidence: REMOTE_COLD_MARKER is written by the real remote SSH startup command.
REMOTE_PROMPT_MARKER is written only after OSC 133 prompt-start is observed and the configured command is sent through xterm input, Tauri IPC, SSH PTY, and terminal output.
AX flags are advisory in remote mode because WebKit does not reliably expose the status label or hidden xterm input element.
limitations: This does not replace macOS physical keyboard, Chinese IME, Option/dead key, cat/history/Tab/vim/nano interaction acceptance.
Windows OpenSSH Agent/Pageant/PTY and serial hardware remain unverified because no test devices are available.
